user.title: Connect to HostKeeper
user.description: Create an API key in the HostKeeper app under Settings → API keys. Choose the “Property operations” preset and restrict the key to the property this Home Assistant looks after — it only needs to open and close tasks.

data_description.api_key: Shown once when you create it, starting hk_live_ or hk_test_.
data_description.base_url: Leave as-is unless you run your own HostKeeper.

property.title: Choose a property
property.description: This key can reach more than one property. Pick the one this Home Assistant is installed at.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your HostKeeper key
reauth_confirm.description: The key for {property} is no longer accepted — it may have been revoked or have expired. Create a new one in the app and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach HostKeeper. Check the server URL and this machine's internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: HostKeeper rejected this key. Check it was copied whole, and that it has not been revoked.
error.no_properties: The key works but can't reach any property. It is probably restricted to a property the account no longer has access to.
error.wrong_property: This key cannot reach the property this entry is set up for. Create one restricted to that property.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This property is already set up.

report.name: Report an alert
report.description: File a maintenance task for a condition that has become true. Safe to call repeatedly.

resolve.name: Resolve an alert
resolve.description: The condition is no longer true. Confirms a completed task, or cancels one that cleared on its own.

block.name: Refute a completion
block.description: The task was marked done but the condition persists.
